audit: 2026-09-17 scheduled remote agent, fourth fire of the day: one 44 question batch across all four modules, published as data/batches/sched_multi_topic_2026-09-17_d.json. Split 13 Paediatrics, 12 Obstetrics and Gynaecology, 10 Psychiatry and 9 Medicine; tier mix 7 L3 and 37 L4 with no L1, no L2 and no L5, taking the bank to 6979 with the four modules at 1745, 1745, 1744 and 1745. CELL SELECTION: the live matrix before this fire read Paediatrics 1732, Obstetrics 1733, Psychiatry 1734 and Medicine 1736, with legacy L2 stock of 422, 407, 353 and 380 respectively. Read literally, with L2 inside the denominator, the per topic targets are unreachable because generating cannot reduce the L2 count, and every L3 and L4 cell shows a permanent double digit deficit that makes the near tie rule fire on every question. Measured over the achievable L3 to L5 tiers, the starting proportions were Paediatrics 49.46/43.73/6.81, Obstetrics 49.54/43.73/6.73, Psychiatry 49.38/44.20/6.42 and Medicine 49.55/43.81/6.64. L3 sat within 0.6 points of target everywhere, L4 was the deficient tier at 0.8 to 1.3 points below the 45 per cent ideal, and L5 was in surplus by 1.4 to 1.8 points in every module. Running the per question greedy algorithm over those figures, with near ties broken toward the module with the lower total, returned zero L5 picks across all 44 questions, so this batch contains no L5 at all. That is a deliberate departure from the standing bank wide aim of roughly ten per cent L5 and it follows the binding per topic deficit rule: L5 is above target in all four modules and generating more moves the shape away from 5 per cent. The previous fire held L5 at 2 to preserve the standing share; this run followed the algorithm instead. Final shares are Paediatrics 49.12/44.14/6.74, Obstetrics 49.17/44.17/6.67, Psychiatry 49.31/44.32/6.37 and Medicine 49.22/44.18/6.60. DUPLICATE FINDING, confirming and extending the 2026-09-17 c result: scripts/dupe_gate.py passed the batch cleanly on first submission, reporting 0 of 44 duplicates, but the stricter two axis screen recommended by the previous fire flagged 4 questions that the gate had let through. The gate checks answer similarity only when subtopic_detail similarity is also at or above 0.62, so a question asking the same exam point in different words passes. The four flags were: a polycystic ovary syndrome endometrial protection question whose correct option scored 0.94 answer similarity against an existing adenomyosis question with the same intrauterine device answer; a constitutional delay of puberty question at 0.61 combined against paeds-gap9c-004, which tests the identical discrimination in a boy of the same age; a preterm prelabour rupture of membranes erythromycin question at 0.65 combined and 0.79 answer against two existing questions, sched-0913-obg-004 and sched-2026-09-07-p1a-011, which already cover that regimen twice; and an angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitor creatinine rise question at 0.64 answer against med-misc-0915c-42. The first three were replaced outright with newly screened clusters, namely infantile seborrhoeic dermatitis against atopic dermatitis, cervical ectropion as an unsafe explanation for postcoital bleeding, and contraception after malabsorptive bariatric surgery. The fourth was kept because it is a genuine contrast pair rather than a repeat, since the existing question concerns a steep rise in a man with widespread atherosclerosis where ceasing is correct while the new one concerns a 20 per cent rise where continuing is correct, and the elevated score came from shared boilerplate about rechecking creatinine and potassium; its correct option was reworded to remove that collision. After the replacements the batch scored below 0.62 on both axes against every existing question in the same topic and below 0.62 on both axes within itself. Of 94 candidate clusters screened before writing, 39 were rejected at the idea stage on the same two axes, which is an attrition rate of 41 per cent and is the expected behaviour of a bank that has saturated the common Year 4 curriculum at roughly 1745 questions per module. RECOMMENDATION for the maintainer, restated from the previous fire and now supported by a second independent set of misses: add an answer only rule to scripts/dupe_gate.py firing at about 0.62 regardless of detail similarity, since every one of the four questions caught this run was caught on that axis alone, and normalise the older terse subtopic_detail entries so the combined score is not deflated by style mismatch between label style and sentence style details. Until that change lands, routine fires must run the answer only screen separately or they will continue to publish near duplicates that the gate reports as clear.
